The '''IGV-55 surveillance vessel''', or '''Imperial listener ship''',<ref name="DB" /> and also referred to technically, as the '''''Gozanti''-class espionage ship''', the '''''Gozanti''-class IGV-55''', or '''''Gozanti''-class IGV-55'''<ref name="SW EOSAOV (SE)" /> or simply, the '''IGV-55'''<ref name="SW EOSAOV (SE)" /> was a [[starship]] model used by the [[Galactic Empire]] for surveillance, intel, and recon.<ref name="DB" /> They were also capable of jamming sensors and long-range communications.<ref name="Squadrons">''[[Star Wars: Squadrons]]''</ref> Utilized by [[Imperial Intelligence]]'s [[Imperial Information Office|Information Office]], these vessels monitored communications and scanned data, looking for signs of seditious activities.<ref name="DB" /> They were similar to the [[Gozanti-class cruiser|''Gozanti''-class cruisers]] modified to serve within the [[Imperial Navy]], although extensively modified with additional sensors and transmitter dishes.<ref name="SWR:DAD-Trivia Gallery" />

==History==
[[File:IGV-55_surveillance_vessel2.png|thumb|left|250px|The IGV-55 surveillance vessel operated by controller LT-319]]
In [[2 BBY]],<ref name="Double Agent Droid date">''[[Dawn of Rebellion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars Rebels: Steps Into Shadow]]'' to seventeen [[Standard year|years]] after the end of the [[Clone Wars]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[19 BBY]]; therefore, the events of ''Steps Into Shadow'' must take place in [[2 BBY]]. According to ''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know, Updated and Expanded]]'', [[Maul]]'s [[Mission to Tatooine (Imperial Era)|final confrontation]] with [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] in "[[Twin Suns (episode)|Twin Suns]]" happened thirty [[Standard year|years]] after Kenobi first [[Duel on Tatooine|saw]] him on [[Tatooine]]. Since ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates that event to [[32 BBY]], "Twin Suns" is set in 2 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]]. "[[Double Agent Droid]]" is set between ''Steps Into Shadow'' and "Twin Suns," so it must also take place in 2 BBY.</ref> a team of Imperial intelligence officers and [[slicer]]s led by the Imperial [[controller]] [[Boon|LT-319]] operated on an IGV-55 surveillance vessel. This [[starship]] was modified to include a strong signal array capable of transmitting and intercepting signals from long distances. Under the leadership LT-319, the team hijacked the rebel [[astromech droid]] [[C1-10P|Chopper]] and attempted to use him to find the location of the [[Phoenix Cell]]'s [[Chopper Base]]. However, their plot was foiled by Chopper's master [[Hera Syndulla]], who transmitted a massive data surge which overwhelmed the cruiser's systems and compromised the fuel cells, causing an explosion which destroyed the ship and its crew.<ref name="SWR-Double Agent Droid" />

Following the [[Battle of Endor]], as the Empire [[Incursion in the Bormea sector|encroached]] on the [[Bormea sector]], jamming ships were deployed as support. They were destroyed by [[Vanguard Squadron]], in short order. Later, more jammers were deployed during the [[Battle of Galitan]] to prevent [[New Republic]] forces from sending a distress signal, though they too were destroyed.<ref name="Squadrons" />

==Behind the scenes==
The IGV-55 surveillance vessel first appeared in "[[Double Agent Droid]],"<ref name="SWR-Double Agent Droid" /> the nineteenth episode of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''{{'}} [[Star Wars Rebels Season Three|third season]].<ref name="SWR:DAD-Episode Guide">{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/double-agent-droid-episode-guide|text="Double Agent Droid" Episode Guide | Star Wars Rebels}}</ref> The ship's overall design, specifically it being a standard freighter that was extensively modified with additional sensor and transmitter dishes, was based on real-world AWACS planes. Likewise, the operations center aboard the vessel, and by extension, the staff aboard the controller, were inspired by the controller rooms seen in George Lucas's first feature-length film, THX 1138.<ref name="SWR:DAD-Trivia Gallery" />
